Photogrammetry for Predictable Full-Arch Restorations

Verified Implant Positions. Better Restorative Outcomes.

A photogrammetry dental workflow designed to support immediate-load provisionals, passive fit restoration objectives, and definitive full-arch prosthetics.

Successful full-arch restorations depend on more than implant placement. Verified implant position data creates a stronger foundation for restorative design, predictable outcomes, and efficient transitions from surgery to final restoration.

Start a Photogrammetry Case Learn more about photogrammetry kits

Why Photogrammetry Matters

Accurate Implant Position Transfer

Full-arch restorative success relies on the accurate transfer of implant position information from surgery into restorative design.

Immediate Passive Restoration

By capturing verified implant positions immediately after surgery, clinicians can restore cases immediately with greater confidence while reducing reliance on traditional verification methods and repeated adjustments.

Predictable Clinical Outcomes

Whether incorporated into guided surgery or freehand protocols, photogrammetry full-arch implant workflows provide a dependable pathway toward more predictable restorative outcomes.

Clinical Applications

Built for Modern
Full-Arch Treatment

Photogrammetry can support a wide range of restorative workflows and treatment modules.

Applications

  • Accurate data capturing , guided or freehand for a seamless immediate temporisation experience.
  • Transition to final restoration, with superior record taking accuracy from try-in to final delivery.
The GFMP Workflow

Guided Full Mouth Photogrammetry

01

Guided Surgery Foundation

Prosthetically driven planning establishes implant positioning that supports restorative objectives from the start.

02

Implant Position Verification

Photogrammetry captures verified implant positions immediately following surgery.

03

Restorative Design

Verified implant data is transferred into restorative workflows for provisional and definitive prosthetics.

04

Transition to Final Restoration

Photogrammetry supports a seamless progression from provisional restorations to definitive prosthetics.

Clinical Flexibility

While these represent commonly used systems, our workflows are not limited to specific platforms. 3DDX can integrate with virtually any photogrammetry system, grammetry protocol, or implant verification kit used in modern implant dentistry.

Proven in Clinical Practice

Photogrammetry workflows have become an important part of modern full-arch restorative treatment, supporting clinicians across guided and freehand protocols.

Explore the full photogrammetry workflow from pre-operative planning to a predictable, esthetic, and immediate temporization result. No pickup needed, just a clean monolithic screw-retained provisional restoration delivered.

Key Benefits

Why Clinicians Choose 3DDX Photogrammetry

Verified Implant Position Capture

High-precision photogrammetry workflows accurately capture the definitive implant positions, establishing a reliable foundation for full-arch restorative design.

Streamlined Photogrammetry Workflow

A structured digital workflow simplifies data capture and transfer, creating an efficient transition from surgery to restorative design and production.

Passive-Fit Restoration Support

Precise implant position data supports passive-fit restoration objectives while helping minimize restorative adjustments and chairside refinements.

Guided & Freehand Compatibility

Flexible workflows support both guided and freehand surgical approaches, adapting seamlessly to different clinical protocols and preferences.

Flexible Production & Clinical Support

Access expert clinical support when needed, with both digital design and physical production options to match your practice workflow.

Scalable Full-Arch Workflows

Standardized processes and flexible production pathways help practices efficiently integrate and scale predictable full-arch treatment.
